title: Geometric, Poisson, and exponential distributions
terms: geometric distribution; Poisson distribution; exponential distribution; memoryless prop- erty; Poisson thinning; rate parameter; homogeneous Poisson process.

An exponential waiting time T with rate λ > 0 has density λe for t ≥ 0, survival probability
−λt 2
P(T > t) = e , mean 1/λ, and variance 1/λ . Exponential and geometric waiting times
are memoryless: after a period without success, the remaining waiting time has the same law.
Independently retaining each event of a Poisson count with probability p gives a Poisson count
with parameter pλ; retained and discarded counts are independent. A homogeneous Poisson
process connects Poisson counts to independent exponential gaps.
For a homogeneous Poisson process of rate λ, disjoint time intervals have independent counts,
and an interval of length t has Poisson mean λt. Successive event gaps are independent expo-
nentials of that rate. Thus the waiting time to the kth event exceeds t exactly when the count
by t is less than k.
